records.text: Jerry Falwell Jr. and Charlie Kirk established the Falkirk Center, and after Falwell’s scandal the effort was replaced by Turning Point Faith.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Jerry Falwell Jr. and Charlie Kirk decided to come together to establish the Falkirk Center... what happened after it fell apart was that they decided to instead create Turning Point Faith.

verification.notes: Official sources support Kirk’s role in launching Liberty’s center and the later launch of TPUSA Faith, but do not establish the claimed direct organizational replacement sequence in full.

records.text: A Liberty University insider allegedly said Jerry Falwell Jr. was unfairly removed from leadership.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep CMcktj3Egfo)

appearances.snippet: And I will say allegedly here, allegedly, they told me that Jerry Falwell Jr. ... Was also taken down, unfairly taken down is what they said.

verification.notes: This is an anonymous insider’s evaluative assertion that Jerry Falwell Jr. was removed unfairly. Public records establish the resignation controversy but cannot verify the source’s private judgment.

appearances.snippet: this person claims that it was corrupt pastors, evangelical pastors, that wanted him out and wanted to put an end to the Falkirk Center.

verification.notes: This anonymous allegation assigns corrupt motive and coordinated intent to unnamed pastors. Public reporting on Falwell’s departure does not substantiate this alleged scheme.

records.text: Jerry Falwell Jr. separated Liberty University’s finances from the church’s finances.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And he had separated it from the church, wanting the finances not to be mingled with the church, which was something that his father had not done.

verification.notes: Reporting documents that Liberty was formally separated from Thomas Road Baptist Church and other Falwell ministries in the late 1990s and became financially self-sufficient, work in which Falwell Jr. played a central legal and financial role.

records.text: After succeeding Jerry Falwell Jr., Jerry Prevo fired Charlie Kirk from Liberty University and reinstated Johnnie Moore.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Jerry Prevo is named as his successor and the very first thing that Jerry Prevo does. ... Is he fires Charlie Kirk and he also moves rather immediately to reinstate none other than the sometimes lurking Johnnie Moore

verification.notes: Prevo succeeded Falwell as acting president in August 2020, not 2021, and Liberty later declined to renew Kirk’s Falkirk affiliation. That supports the “fired Kirk” gist but not the stated chronology; independent evidence that Prevo reinstated Johnnie Moore was not located.
